files.removedNote: Removed with the move to OpenZeppelin 5.3.0 TransparentUpgradeableProxy + ProxyAdmin (the components/wsteth-token/lib/openzeppelin-contracts-5.3.0 submodule, compiled by the token build). Fleet proxies already on-chain keep running the OssifiableProxy bytecode; its source is in this file's git history and in each run's inputs/ snapshot.

notes: Historical source hashes describe the original imports, not current file contents. The MIT-licensed BurnMintERC20BridgedPermit extension was merged into ERC20BridgedPermit (roles, atomic initialization, implementation locking and mint/burn). ERC20Bridged comments now refer to the merged contract. Other imported upstream sources remain unchanged. On 2026-10-08 the dependency baseline moved to the editions the CCIP token deployment uses: OpenZeppelin contracts + upgradeable 5.0.2 for the implementation (AccessControlEnumerableUpgradeable now at access/extensions/, ERC-7201 namespaced storage), OpenZeppelin 5.3.0 TransparentUpgradeableProxy + ProxyAdmin as the proxy, Solidity 0.8.26 / paris. OssifiableProxy.sol was removed (fleet proxies already on-chain keep it; new deployments use the Transparent proxy). PermitExtension no longer inherits OpenZeppelin EIP712: it derives the domain from immutables so the implementation keeps no linear storage beyond ERC20Core slots 0-2. The sha256 values above still describe the original imports. The OssifiableProxy.sol entry above is kept as import history and marked removed.
